text:
Anna G: Heads-up — CloudMarket GA next week. We need a clear SEV path and a shared ops channel for marketplace integrations. Proposing #partner-cloudmarket-ops and a private war-room for sev1s. Thoughts?
Mike R: +1 on separate war-room. Recommend public ops channel for async updates and a private #pm-cloudmarket-warroom for live SEV. Who owns first responder?
Jess C: Support can own first-triage for GA partners (we'll ack within 15m during business hours). Need partner contact matrix and escalation levels.
Anna G: Partner PM gave primary/backup: Luca (pm) / Priya (eng) — I'll DM their mobile numbers to the triage leads.
Deepak S: From infra side, we'll need a service account and RBAC for the partner channel integrations (PD + logging). Can infra create the channel and hook PD?
Anna G: I'll create the public ops channel and the private war-room now. Naming convention: #partner-<vendor>-ops and #partner-<vendor>-warroom. Keeping consistent across partners.
Oncall Bot: Channel #partner-cloudmarket-ops created by anna.g
Jess C: Drafting a minimal runbook for initial triage — pasting skeleton here so we can iterate:
```
SEV1 triage (first 15m):
1) Confirm incident and impact (service graph, recent deploys)
2) Collect core logs: inference-rt, routing-proxy, model-cache (last 30m)
3) If degraded latency only -> scale dedicated pool / switch traffic to fallback model
4) If full outage -> escalate to war-room and trigger PD escalation policy
```
Mike R: I'll handle PD integration and rotation. Proposed SRE rota: Mike R (primary), Deepak S (primary-2), Sara L (backup). Also add an automated runbook step to capture traces and dump kv-cache.
Anna G: Action items: (1) Anna — channels created (done) (2) Jess — upload detailed runbook v1 to confluence by EOD Thurs (3) Mike — PD + webhooks by EOD Fri (4) Support — confirm oncall handoff times.
Jess C: I'll post the runbook link in #partner-cloudmarket-ops once it's up. tagging @mike.r for PD creds. :thumbsup:
Mike R: Received. Will confirm PD config and post a test alert in the ops channel tomorrow morning.
Anna G: Thanks everyone — keeping this low-friction. If SEV1 occurs, use private war-room and tag @oncall-sre. We'll iterate after the first drill.
